figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 2. Chromatograms were obtained from a UV detector (A) and mass spectrometer (C-F). A mass spectrum (B) scanning for masses ranging
from m/z 600 to 1500 for retention time (*) 17.55 min reveals two major ions (m/z 1087 and 1109). Each centroid represents compound 2 associated
with a proton adduct or sodium adduct, respectively. The mass chromatogram was obtained from 1 mL samples for titer quatitation at each time
point according to varying culture conditions: M9 minimal medium with a single dose of QXC (C), M9 minimal medium with a daily dose of QXC
(D), LB medium with a daily dose of QXC (E), and M9 minimal medium devoid of QXC dosing (F).

figure_candidates.label: Figure 3
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 3. Comparison of three 50 mL cultures differing in medium
and the method in which the bicyclic starter unit is furnished: ([) M9
minimal medium culture with a single dose of QXC at the point of
induction; (b) M9 minimal medium culture supplied daily with 5 mg
of QXC; and (9) LB medium culture supplied daily with 5 mg of QXC.
The data points are averaged values of three runs.

figure_candidates.label: Figure 4
figure_candidates.caption:
Figure 4. Correlation of OD600 ([) and pH (0) of small culture over
time: (A) culture in M9 minimal medium furnished with QXC at the
point of induction for a final concentration of 0.1 mg/mL; (B) culture
in M9 minimal medium furnished daily with 5 mg of QXC; and (C)
culture in LB medium furnished daily with 5 mg of QXC. The data
points are averaged values of three runs.
